evals.prompt: Spin up a native SwiftUI app around my existing public-art API and get the first build onto my iPhone through TestFlight.
evals.expected_output: An end-to-end plan and execution sequence from concept gate through a physically installed TestFlight build, with runtime and credential boundaries.
expectations: Runs the 4.3 concept gate before implementation
Uses a thin app, feature package, and UI-free API package
Requires processing verification and physical TestFlight installation

evals.prompt: My new native app builds in the simulator. Please create its Apple record, prepare the first beta, and upload it to TestFlight.
evals.expected_output: A first-beta workflow covering release compliance, tests, listing assets, App Store identity, authorized signing, upload, and VALID processing.
expectations: Routes credential-bearing operations to Claude Code CLI
Distinguishes API keys, certificates, private keys, and provisioning profiles
Does not declare success at archive or upload time

evals.prompt: BrewDesk is already on TestFlight. Finish the listing questionnaires and submit it for App Review.
evals.expected_output: A handoff to store-submission rather than rerunning first-TestFlight bootstrap.
expectations: Recognizes that the app is past this skill's endpoint

evals.prompt: Help me run BrewDesk locally while changing the sibling bamware-ios package.
evals.expected_output: A handoff to native-ios-workspace rather than invoking the release workflow.
expectations: Does not begin App Store or TestFlight work
